name: Tucker Kennedy
profile: Charismatic singer/songwriter with a warm, confident frontman presence.
visualIdentity: Clean cut, short-to-medium natural hair, five o’clock shadow, long-sleeve shirt, blue or black jeans, cowboy hat, and occasional aviator sunglasses.
bio: Tucker “Tuck” Kennedy grew up three houses away from David Daniels in Smithtown, New York. The two became inseparable childhood friends and were inspired to learn guitar after experiencing a live concert at Jones Beach. Tuck later studied business upstate, while staying connected to the band before returning to the group and helping build its original catalog and live presence.
